blocks.value: Inheritance lets a class take on the properties of another class, avoiding repeated code across related classes. Apply it with the extends keyword.

An interface is a component that defines the headings for a set of public methods. Some interfaces cover every public method a class needs, others only specify certain ones. A class uses an interface via the implements keyword.

A package groups related classes and interfaces into a folder. The folder's name is the package's name, and each class lives in its own file named after that class. Import any class from a package to use it elsewhere, even outside that package's folder:

import java.util.Scanner;   // import one class
import java.util.*;         // import every class in the package
